_comment_assembly: Real retail assets (Data/buildings/nod/mnobl/building.json in the installed game; every loadByDefault part, copied to data/building_models/nod/mnobl) -- see docs/zerohour/BuildingComponentAssembly.md. Not loaded (loadByDefault false in the manifest): blck.w3d (blocker), mnobl_ext_n.w3d (nightVariant), MNobl_ag_3n.w3d (nightVariant), mnobl_int_tmp.w3d (temporarySource), mnobl_vis.w3d (visibilityHelper), mnobl_visx.w3d (visibilityHelper), tmp_ground.w3d (temporarySource).
_comment_anchors: MNOBL_MCT~ is the exact hierarchy pivot name in mnobl_int.w3d; the trailing ~ is part of the name, and HTreeClass::Get_Bone_Index matches exactly.
_comment_footprint: Measured: twice the largest |X| and |Y| of the exterior mesh bounds, rounded up (the footprint is centred on the building origin).
_comment_semantic_anchors: Local-frame points read from the retail model data, not guessed. mct: MNOBL_MCT~ pivot in mnobl_int.w3d; pct: MNOBL#PCT_H1A01 pivot in MNobl_ag_2.w3d. Roles not listed have no source in the model data and are left out.
